messages.subject: Re: issues with gbm
parts:
Thanks for reporting this.

Please get the latest version of the package from GitHub
(https://github.com/gbm-developers/gbm) and let us know if you still
have the same issue. Please run the example several times and confirm
that it fails every time. My first guess is that the cross-validation
is failing to pick up on some rare classes, so please check using the
stratify.cv argument (if you haven't already).

Finally, please post it as an Issue on the GitHub pages. It's much
less likely to get lost or forgotten that way.

Again, thanks. It's appreciated.
Harry


On 29 October 2015 at 18:23, Qianyi Zhang <zhang_...@lilly.com> wrote:
> Dear Dr. Greg Ridgeway,
>
>
>
> I am running a gbm analysis using “poisson” distribution with an offset of
> treatment duration to predict the count of an adverse event. When I used
> cv.folds=10, there was an error message “Error in object$var.levels[[i]] :
> subscript out of bounds” . When cv.folds=0, no error message returns. I
> rerun the analysis with distribution =”gaussian” and cv.folds=10 on the log
> of event rate, the task was completed without any error. So it seems there
> may be some bugs for “poisson” distribution using cross validation. Can you
> fix the issue?
>
>
>
> BTW, when I used an older version of gbm (1.6-3.2) on the same data with the
> distribution of poisson and cv.folds=10, the task was completed without any
> error. I guess the issue may be due to some conflicts with the current
> updates.
>
>
>
> Thank you for reading this email and look forward to your reply.
>
>
>
> Bests,
